description: The converter marks every member named like an access key sensitive, which catches `MskIamUser.accessKeyId`, the IAM credentials of the MSK, Kinesis and S3 ClickPipes sources. The spec describes it as 'IAM access key ID.': the public half of the key pair, an identifier like a key ID, while its secret (`secretKey`, 'IAM secret key.') stays sensitive. IDs stay plain strings (distilled-sdk skill, Credentials). Source: the OpenAPI document served at https://api.clickhouse.cloud/v1 (2026-11-11).
